title: Here's who signed up to run for Georgia House District 23 - NewsBreak
text:
By Shannon Ballew ,
12 hours ago This map shows the area for Georgia House District 23 in Cherokee County. To check which state House district you live in, go to https://mvp.sos.ga.gov. By Staff/Jennifer Hall Five Republicans and one Democrat have signed up to run for the Georgia House seat formerly represented by state Rep. Mandi Ballinger.
Qualifying ended Wednesday for the special election for Georgia House District 23, which is set for Dec. 9.
The district includes portions of north and central Cherokee County, including Canton.
Ballinger, a Republican from Canton, represented the district for over a decade until she died last month after a battle with cancer.
Six candidates have signed up to run for the seat, according to the Georgia Secretary of State’s website:
♦ Ann Gazell, Republican, a retired educator and president of the Holly Springs Police Foun♦ dation
♦ Bill Fincher, Republican, owner and operator of Plum Nelly RV Park in Ellijay and a retired assistant district attorney
♦ Brice Futch, Republican, a firefighter and paramedic and leader of Stand for Georgia Values
♦ Rajpal “Raj” Sagoo, Republican, a consultant and managing partner of Artha Investment Partners in Canton
♦ Scott Sanders, Democrat, an engineer
♦ William Ware, Republican, a retired microbiologist from the USDA
The last day to register to vote for this election is Nov. 10. Early in-person voting is set to start on Nov. 17.
Absentee by mail applications for this election will be accepted through Dec. 1.
Only registered voters in State House District 23 will be able to vote in the special election. To check what district you live in and other voter information, visit mvp.sos.ga.gov.
If a runoff is needed, it will be held Jan. 6.
Like the special election held in August for state Senate, this will be a “jungle” election, meaning all candidates will appear on the same ballot, regardless of party.
